title: Highland Resources
description: A small set of custom textures for LOTC
body:
## Highland Resources Step deeper into the world of Lord of the Craft with Highland Resources, a custom resource pack designed to enhance your roleplay immersion. This pack introduces fully custom textures for LOTC’s unique plugin-based items, while leaving vanilla Minecraft untouched. That means you can enjoy the look and feel of specialized weapons and tools without losing the classic style of the base game. ## Features ✔️ Unique, lore-inspired textures for custom LOTC items
✔️ Preserves vanilla Minecraft textures for compatibility
## Textured Items Include: Weapons: Shortsword, Longsword, Swordbreaker, Spear, Pike, Lance, Jousting Lance, Warhammer, Berserker Axe, Great Axe & Mace Ranged Gear: Javelin, Shortbow & Longbow Utility & Tools: Buckler, Bolt Cutters, Lockpick & Horse Whistle
